source.title: Grow your email list from comments
source.original_goal: Grow your email list from comments
source.demand_evidence: Catalogue presence only; popularity and conversion are unmeasured.

goal: Deliver a resource and offer optional email collection after an inbound answer.

post_ids.description: 1-50 actual selected Instagram post IDs read from this account.

keyword.description: Exact comment or inbound DM campaign word, at most 50 characters.

resource_title.description: Coach-supplied resource title, preserved without invented claims.

resource_url.description: Coach-supplied resource url, preserved without invented claims.

contact_purpose.description: Explicit voluntary contact purpose; not implicit marketing consent.

language.description: Coach's message language; provide the exact approved copy in this language.

public_text.description: Exact complete coach-approved public text in language, within this recipe's unchanged promise and transitions.

initial_text.description: Exact complete coach-approved initial text in language, within this recipe's unchanged promise and transitions.

refusal_text.description: Exact complete coach-approved refusal text in language, within this recipe's unchanged promise and transitions.

handoff_text.description: Exact complete coach-approved handoff text in language, within this recipe's unchanged promise and transitions.

messages.initial: Here is {resource_title}: {resource_url}. Reply MORE to continue.
messages.continuation: After MORE, offer optional email capture for contact_purpose. Accept a plain-language refusal without withholding the resource.
messages.refusal: Understood. I will not continue this campaign. You can ask our team for help.
messages.handoff: Our team will handle your request.

transitions.event: Coach supplies approved business facts and selects the existing account.
transitions.action: Prepare exact messages and native payloads locally; obtain scoped approvals and save private intent.
transitions.evidence: Preview, recipe digest and private card readback.

transitions.event: The contact comments the exact campaign word under an approved post.
transitions.action: Provide the real entry event; an external click is not a reply.
transitions.evidence: Actual account, recipient, media/word and entry event IDs.

transitions.event: The approved native automation receives that entry.
transitions.action: Send exactly one initial message containing the approved value or question.
transitions.evidence: Recipient-side first message and linked source.

transitions.event: The contact actually replies within the permitted window.
transitions.action: After MORE, offer optional email capture for contact_purpose. Accept a plain-language refusal without withholding the resource.
transitions.evidence: A valid voluntary email is captured; a refusal remains a completed resource delivery.

outcome: A valid voluntary email is captured; a refusal remains a completed resource delivery.
negative_cases: No SKIP button is required or invented.
No mailing consent is inferred from an address alone.

resume.action: Restore the private card, confirm this recipe digest and account, then read current owned and shared settings. Reconcile unknown results without retry.
resume.campaign_match: Require the actual media, commentID and linked private reply; do not infer campaign from lead stage.

stop.action: Disable only the campaign-owned comment rule, if present. Remove only campaign additions from shared DM text, captures and handoff; retain other campaigns and support.
stop.proof: Read back changes. Test late entry, late DM, the second campaign and ordinary support before accepting complete stop.

resource_received_before_email.description: The promised resource is delivered before optional email collection.

voluntary_email_saved.description: Native capture saves the actual agreed email.
